annotation.title_clean: 人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の適正性確保に関する指針
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on Ensuring Appropriateness in the Research, Development and Utilization of AI-Related Technologies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 人工知能戦略本部 (AI Strategy Headquarters, Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's AI Strategy Headquarters guideline, issued under Article 13 of the 2025 AI Promotion Act, setting voluntary principles for appropriate AI R&D and use. It sets out human-centricity, fairness, safety, transparency, accountability and security, plus duties for developers, businesses, government and citizens. It has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary guideline under Article 13 of Japan's AI Act (Act No. 53 of Reiwa 7) for all actors
Principles: human-centric, fairness, safety, transparency, accountability, security, privacy, fair competition, AI literacy, innovation
Basic policies: risk-based approach, stakeholder involvement, end-to-end AI governance, agile response
Developers and businesses should build AI governance, use ISO/IEC 42001 and the Hiroshima Process reporting framework, and disclose information
Government to promote AI literacy, appoint AI governance officers and keep guidance under agile review
